  "description": "1 Warehouse Planning & Resource Optimization
* Develop workload, manpower, capacity, equipment, working hours and overtime plans based on operational demand.
* Optimize resource allocation across processes, shifts and departments.
* Monitor actual performance against plans and adjust resources accordingly.
* Identify manpower and capacity gaps and recommend solutions.

2 Capacity & Expansion Planning
* Analyze historical data and forecasts to determine future workload and capacity requirements.
* Evaluate warehouse capacity and identify expansion or new warehouse requirements.
* Assess potential warehouse locations based on capacity, layout, manpower, equipment, cost and operational feasibility.
* Develop scenarios and provide recommendations for warehouse expansion and new warehouse implementation.

3 Productivity & Cost Analysis
* Analyze productivity, manpower utilization, overtime, labor cost and operational capacity.
* Identify key performance gaps and recommend improvement actions.
* Develop scenarios for peak seasons, business expansion, volume changes and capacity increases.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to support management decisions.

4 Process Improvement & Automation
* Standardize and improve Warehouse planning processes, tools and methodologies.
* Drive planning automation and digital solutions to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Lead Continuous Improvement initiatives related to planning and resource optimization.

5 Team Management
* Lead, coach and develop Warehouse Planning and Training teams.
* Ensure planning activities are accurate, timely and aligned with business requirements.
* Support management in implementing resource, capacity and Warehouse development plans.",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:
3 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  3 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên

Candidate Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or related fields.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Warehouse / Supply Chain planning or Warehouse Management.
* Experience in workload, manpower, capacity, productivity and resource planning.
* Good understanding of Warehouse operations and WMS is preferred.
* Experience in warehouse expansion / new warehouse evaluation is an advantage.
* Experience in Lean, Kaizen or Continuous Improvement is preferred.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills with good data analysis and presentation capabilities.

CORE COMPETENCIES
* Warehouse & Capacity Planning
* Manpower & Resource Optimization
